headline: Sensex and Nifty recover from early lows as Bank Nifty hits record high despite global AI sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Global sell-off in AI-related technology stocks weighing on market sentiment
Sharp overnight decline in the Nasdaq index and GIFT Nifty
US Federal Reserve signals regarding potential for further interest rate hikes
Profit-taking and weak global cues following a drop in Asian markets
whatHappening: Sensex recovered 600 points from its low to trade at a day's high
Nifty Bank hit a fresh record high while Nifty reclaimed the 25,600 level
The Indian Rupee strengthened past the 93 mark against the US Dollar
Jewellery stocks like Titan and Kalyan Jewellers fell for a third consecutive day
summary: Indian markets recovered from an early slump caused by a global AI sell-off and Fed rate hike concerns. The Nifty Bank achieved a new record high, while the Sensex and Nifty reclaimed key psychological levels. Jewellery stocks declined as gold prices hit 2026 lows, though the Rupee saw a significant rally past 93 per Dollar.
